basis.control: reactors only: stored bs_mvar minus ParameterEstimator.capacitor_bank_targets/1, applied in memory. Deriving on a network that already carries the banks would measure the residual and shrink the study on every re-run.
basis.note: alpha is each island's AC loadability ceiling. It is well below 1.0, so these shortfalls are measured on a lightly loaded network and are conservative.
basis.shortfall: q_free - q_max, where q_free is the bus's reactive output with generator q_max x10 at the same alpha. Only buses PINNED at q_max in the base solve are listed.
basis.snapshot: Grid.get_grid_snapshot(ic.id, hour: hour) -> Cascade.init(snap, 100.0, hour: hour) -> dispatched_generators/1; largest island of Solver.Partition.split/1
basis.vm_pu: bus voltage in the BASE solve at that alpha
